name: L8 Protocol
description: Trustless webhook delivery via Ed25519 challenge-response handshake. No shared secrets. Ownership proven once, trust cached locally. All deliveries carry signed headers the receiver verifies without any network call. 0.2 adds optional payload encryption to the receiver's X25519 key and optional per-route JSON Schemas for request bodies.

receiver_endpoints.description: Returns receiver identity and public key. Required to participate in L8.

response.public_key: string — base64 Ed25519 public key (32 bytes raw)
response.challenge_endpoint: string — path or full URL, e.g. '/l8/challenge'
response.encryption_public_key: string, optional (0.2): base64 X25519 public key, 32 bytes raw; required if encrypted_payloads is advertised
response.schema_hash: string, optional (0.2): opaque version of request_schemas; SHOULD be 'sha256:' + hex sha256 of RFC 8785 canonical request_schemas; required if request_schemas is present
response.request_schemas: object, optional (0.2): map of 'METHOD /path' to a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for that route's request body

receiver_endpoints.description: Challenge-response handshake. Sender proves it owns its private key, receiver proves it owns its private key. Trust established on both sides.

request.timestamp: integer — Unix seconds, must be within 300s of receiver clock

reject_if: nonce has been seen before (replay protection)

signed_delivery_headers.X-L8-Key-Id: base64 of first 8 bytes of sender public key

verification.sender_public_key_source: obtained during handshake or from sender's /.well-known/l8
verification.on_failure: re-fetch sender's /.well-known/l8 in case of key rotation, then retry once before rejecting

trust_cache.description: One file per trusted domain. Delete to force re-handshake.

file_format.encryption_public_key: string, optional: present when the receiver advertised encrypted_payloads

graceful_degradation: If /.well-known/l8 returns non-200, delivery proceeds without L8 headers. Receivers that do not implement L8 are unaffected.

key_management.env_var: L8_PRIVATE_KEY — base64 raw Ed25519 private key (64 bytes). Takes priority over key file.
key_management.key_file: .l8-key — raw Ed25519 private key bytes. Auto-generated on first start if neither env var nor file exists.
key_management.public_key_derivation: Public key is always derived from the private key. Only one secret to manage.

future_versions.0.3: Formalized key rotation and trust expiry

payload_encryption.opt_in: receiver advertises capability 'encrypted_payloads' and 'encryption_public_key'; senders MUST then encrypt every delivery
steps: ephemeral X25519 key pair per delivery
key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=shared, salt=ephemeral_public || encryption_public_key, info='l8/0.2 payload', length=32)
ciphertext = AES-256-GCM(key, nonce=12 random bytes, aad='{delivery_id}.{timestamp}'), tag appended
sign the ciphertext with the normal signed_delivery_headers (encrypt-then-sign)
payload_encryption.receiver: verify X-L8-Signature over the ciphertext first, then decrypt

request_schemas.route_key: 'METHOD /path', method case-insensitive, path exact, no query string
request_schemas.change_signal: upstream sends 'X-Aqueduct-Schema-Hash: <schema_hash>' on responses; a differing value means drop cached schemas and trust, refetch /.well-known/l8, re-run the handshake
sender_rules: SHOULD reject a mismatching body with HTTP 422 before sending
routes without a schema, or metadata that fails to fetch or compile, are not checked
